record.question: A man is facing South. He turns 90° clockwise, then 180° anticlockwise, and finally 90° clockwise again; in which direction is he facing now?
record.explanation: From south, 90° clockwise points west; 180° anticlockwise then points east; another 90° clockwise returns to south. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
